doc.interviewee: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack")

title: Trombonists: Ory, Peter Bocage and Dutrey
summary: Billy recalls Ory and Peter Bocage, an all-round New Orleans musician, playing for them, then Dutrey.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Yes. That's right. Was Oliver Everwith, Orr was with us one time. Eddie Orr, he was among the first.
And then they had a man in New Orleans that was an all around man, played all instruments. He played trombone for us a while, Peter Bocard.
Oh yes, he's still active, he still plays trombone.
He plays violins, still plays violins.
Yes, yes, yes. Play an instrument. Then Wilbur Parrish that she named.
And what was the trombone player was at Peter Albert.
You know Dutre? I never knew him, but I know of him.
